title: Teddy Hale ages out as shadow and becomes Green's student
summary: Ted Lewis kept a registry of shadows who aged out; Hale became a tap dancer, Green's student, and Ellington put him to work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
